services.name: Bathroom Renovations
services.title_tag: Bathroom Renovations Cape Town | Waterproofed and Tiled
services.meta_description: Bathroom renovations in Cape Town with the waterproofing done properly: falls to the drain, flood-tested membranes and tiling that lasts. Free estimate.

leader.cta_line: A bathroom is a waterproofing job with tiles on top. If the layer under the tiles is wrong, the finish does not matter.

services.intro_heading: The part you cannot see is the whole job
services.intro_body:
Most failed bathrooms in Cape Town fail the same way. Water gets behind the tiles, sits on the slab or in the wall, and finds the ceiling of the room below. By the time the paint blisters downstairs, the damage has been happening for months. Retiling over a failed waterproofing membrane is the single most common way owners spend money twice.

So the sequence we insist on is: strip the room back to the structure, repair whatever the water has damaged, fall the floor to the drain, waterproof the floor and the wet walls, flood test it, and only then tile. The flood test is not optional for us. Filling the floor with water and leaving it there tells you whether the membrane is sound before it disappears under tile.

We also look at the things that make a bathroom work after the photos are taken: where the water goes when the shower is running, whether the extractor actually vents outside, whether the door clears the new floor level, and whether there is somewhere to put a towel that is not the back of a chair.
services.detail_intro: From strip-out to the last silicone bead, including the waterproofing and the services that usually need moving.

services.name: Home Renovations
services.title_tag: Home Renovations Cape Town | Full House Refurbishment
services.meta_description: Home renovations in Cape Town. Layout changes, structural openings, kitchens, bathrooms and finishes run by one team with a written scope. Free estimate.

leader.cta_line: Whole-house work, or one part of the house done properly. Same team, same written scope, same sequence.

services.intro_heading: What a full renovation actually involves
services.intro_body:
A whole-house renovation is not one big job. It is a dozen jobs that have to happen in the right order, and the order is what separates a smooth project from a house that is open for months. Structural work before services. Services before closing walls. Waterproofing before finishes. Finishes before the snag list.

Cape Town's housing stock makes this more interesting than it sounds. A 1950s Goodwood house has solid brick walls, no cavity and a damp course that may or may not still work. A 1970s Bellville house may have been extended twice, each time with a roof tied into the last one. A newer Durbanville home has modern services but detailing at parapets and balconies that was value-engineered at construction.

We plan around the structure you actually have. Sometimes that means keeping a wall that a plan said to remove, because it is carrying more than the drawing showed. Sometimes it means opening a room differently to avoid moving a drain. We will always tell you which is which, and what each option costs, before demolition starts.
services.detail_intro: Anything from a single room to a full refurbishment, with the trades sequenced by one team.

cost.heading: What changes the price of a home renovation
rows: Whether walls move
Removing a wall means structural support, making good and often new finishes on both sides.
Services condition
Old wiring and galvanised pipes found behind a wall turn a cosmetic job into a first-fix job.
How much is replaced
Keeping and restoring original floors and doors can cost less than new, and look better.
Water damage found
Roof and damp problems are usually discovered once ceilings are open. We price the repair, not a rebuild.
Phasing
Working room by room so the family stays in the house takes longer but costs less in disruption.
cost.note: We quote a full-house job in sections, so you can see the cost of each part and decide what to do now and what to do later.

services.name: Plastering
services.title_tag: Plastering Cape Town | Skimming, Cracks and Cornices
services.meta_description: Plastering in Cape Town: skimming, crack repair, cornices, external plaster and plasterboard ceilings. Surface prepared properly before paint.

leader.eyebrow: Plastering and surface repair, Cape Town
leader.cta_line: A wall is only as good as the plaster under the paint. Cracks, hollow patches and blown render all start here.

services.intro_heading: Fix the plaster, or paint it twice
services.intro_body:
Plaster fails in Cape Town for reasons that are usually visible once you know what to look for. Movement cracks follow the line of a lintel or a joint between two materials. Hollow-sounding patches mean the plaster has lost its bond to the brick behind it. Powdering, salt-stained plaster at low level means moisture is coming through the wall, and no amount of skim will hold it.

We treat plaster as a repair job before a finishing job. Cracks are opened, not filled. Hollow plaster is cut back to sound material, not skimmed over. Where damp is the cause, the source is fixed before the wall is re-plastered, and where the wall needs to breathe we use a render that lets it.

For interior work, skimming an old wall flat is often the fastest way to make a room feel new without touching the structure. For exteriors, the priorities are different: weather resistance, crack control and a finish that can take the wind and the sun.
services.detail_intro: Interior and exterior, new work and repair, including the ceilings and mouldings that usually need attention at the same time.

subitems.name: Skimming
subitems.desc: A thin, flat finish over sound plaster or plasterboard, ready for paint.

subitems.name: Crack repair
subitems.desc: Cracks opened, reinforced where they are likely to move again, filled and finished flush.

subitems.name: Hollow and blown plaster
subitems.desc: Unsound plaster cut back to a keyed surface and replaced, so the patch does not sound different from the wall.

subitems.name: Cornices and mouldings
subitems.desc: Replacement and repair, with profiles matched to what is already in the house.

subitems.name: External plaster and render
subitems.desc: Weather-facing repair and re-render, with the mix chosen for exposure and breathability.

subitems.name: Plasterboard ceilings
subitems.desc: New ceilings, bulkheads and repairs, taped and skimmed ready for paint.

cost.heading: What changes the price of plastering
rows: Repair or replace
Skimming a sound wall is quick. Cutting out and replacing blown plaster is not.
Height and access
Double volumes and stairwells need scaffolding, which costs as much as the plastering.
What is on the wall
Old enamel, wallpaper glue and multiple paint layers all have to be removed before new plaster will bond.
Matching existing
Cornice profiles and textured finishes take time to match, and sometimes a mould has to be made.
Drying time
New plaster has to dry before paint. Rushing it is how you get a finish that fails in the first winter.
cost.note: We price plastering per wall or per room after seeing the surface, and we tell you when plaster is not the real problem.

steps.detail: Tap for hollow areas, check crack patterns, and establish whether moisture is involved.
Cut back unsound plaster, open cracks, remove failed coatings and key the surface.
Where damp or movement is behind the failure, that is dealt with before new plaster goes on.
Base coat and finish coat applied to the right thickness, with corners and reveals set true.
Sanded, checked under light and handed over dry, so the painter is not correcting our work.

whyus.point: We cut back, not cover up
whyus.detail: Hollow plaster is removed to a sound base, so the repair does not fail beside the patch.
Plastering over a damp wall is a waste of both our time and your money.
Existing profiles reproduced rather than replaced with a near-enough modern section.
We hand over a surface that takes paint properly, not one that needs sanding by someone else.

services.cta_subtext: Get a written plastering estimate, including an honest view of what is repair and what is replacement.
services.teaser: Skimming, crack repair, cornices, external plaster and plasterboard ceilings, finished ready to paint.

services.name: Home Extensions
services.title_tag: Home Extensions Cape Town | Additions and Extra Rooms
services.meta_description: Home extensions in Cape Town: extra rooms, open-plan additions and covered patios, with the roof tie-in and waterproofing detailed properly.

leader.cta_line: An extension is judged by the join. Where the new roof meets the old one is where most of them fail.

services.intro_heading: The join decides whether it lasts
services.intro_body:
Adding a room is straightforward in principle: foundations, walls, a roof, and a hole in the existing house to connect the two. What decides whether the extension is still sound in ten years is the detailing at the junction, and that is the part that gets rushed.

A new roof tied into an old one needs the flashing to be rebuilt, not sealed. A new slab meeting an old wall needs the damp course to be continuous, or the old wall starts drawing water from the new floor. A new opening in an existing wall needs a lintel of the right size and bearing, and the wall above it supported while the opening is formed.

We build extensions as structural work first and finishes second. Where the City of Cape Town requires plans and approval, we work with your architect or draughtsman, or tell you what needs to be submitted before we start. We would rather delay a start than build something that has to be undone.

cost.heading: What changes the price of an extension
rows: Ground conditions
Slope, rock and old foundations all change the excavation and the foundation design.
The junction
A simple lean-to roof against a wall is cheaper than tying a new pitched roof into an existing one.
Approvals
Plans, engineer input and council submission add cost and time before the first brick.
Services
Extending water, waste, power and drainage to the new room is often underestimated.
Finishes
Matching the existing house costs more than making the extension obviously new.
cost.note: We quote the structure and the finishes separately, so the cost of the building work is visible before you choose fittings.

steps.detail: Site visit, measured survey and an honest view of what the plot and the existing house will allow.

Excavation, foundation, slab or suspended floor, walls and the structural opening into the house.
New roof, tie-in to the existing roof, flashings, and the extension closed before finishes begin.
